title: Object abroad too large to move
summary: Eric Burles tells of Object abroad too large to move, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There is reportedly an object that is not in this country that is so large it cannot be moved.

plain: Eric Burles, a US congressman, says he has heard that there is an object held outside the United States that is so big it cannot be moved. He gives this as a reported claim, without saying where it is or who told him. If true, it would point to a recovered craft too large to bring home.
